meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 会变成编排者:把计划按阶段拆开,派子代理分别做实现、验证、反模式检查、代码质量审查和提交;它自己只做协调、传递上下文和核对清单,验证通过才提交。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份计划时接管,尤其是 make-plan 生成的那种计划。

say.text: 照这份计划开始执行第一阶段
say.note: 会派出实现子代理,并要求回报证据

say.text: 验证一下上一阶段是否真的做完了
say.note: 会派验证子代理跑清单

say.text: 验证通过了,提交这一阶段

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it splits the plan into phases and deploys subagents for implementation, verification, anti-pattern checks, code review and commits, coordinating and checking checklists itself. It commits only after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one produced by make-plan.

say_en.text: Start executing phase one of this plan
say_en.note: An implementation subagent is deployed with required evidence

say_en.text: Verify whether the last phase really finished
say_en.note: A verification subagent runs the checklist
No commit happens if it fails
